# Self-hosting Statup

The self-hosting guide moved to the documentation: [statup.dev/docs](https://statup.dev/docs/).

- [Install](https://statup.dev/docs/install/) and [put a reverse proxy in front](https://statup.dev/docs/reverse-proxy/)
- [Every setting](https://statup.dev/docs/configuration/)
- [Back up](https://statup.dev/docs/backups/), [upgrade](https://statup.dev/docs/upgrading/) and [recover a forgotten password](https://statup.dev/docs/forgotten-password/)

Its source is the [documentation](../documentation/) folder of this repository, published with each release.
